provenance.source: wowhandbook.com talent data extracted from WoW: Forever beta client
provenance.notes: Beta build 1.60.1.70425; talent data may still change before the Nov 5 launch. Cross-checked against Blizzard class deep-dive posts.

description.zh: 使你的凿击技能持续时间延长1.5秒。
description.en: Increases the duration of your Gouge ability by 1.5 sec.

description.zh: 击杀一个能为你提供经验值或荣誉值的敌人后，使你的下一次邪恶攻击、背刺、伏击、毁伤或鬼魅攻击的爆击几率提高40%。持续20秒。
description.en: After killing a non-trivial enemy, gives you a 40% increased critical strike chance on your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Mutilate, or Ghostly Strike. Lasts 20 sec.

description.zh: 使你所有攻击和毒药的爆击几率提高5%。
description.en: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks and Poisons by 5%.

description.zh: 使你的终结技有60%的几率为目标增加一个连击点数。
description.en: Gives your finishing moves a 60% chance to add a Combo Point to your target.

description.zh: 对人型和巨人目标造成的所有伤害提高4%。
description.en: Increases all damage dealt by 4% against Humanoid and Giant targets.

description.zh: 使你的切割技能的效果持续时间延长45%。
description.en: Increases the duration of your Slice and Dice ability by 45%.

description.zh: 你的终结技每消耗一个连击点数都有20%的几率恢复25点能量。
description.en: Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per Combo Point to restore 25 Energy.

description.zh: 使你的破甲消耗的能量值降低10点，并在以5个连击点数施放时返还2个连击点。
description.en: Reduces the Energy cost of your Expose Armor ability by 10, and refunds 2 Combo Points when cast with 5 Combo Points.

description.zh: 使你的邪恶攻击、凿击、背刺、毁伤、鬼魅攻击和出血技能的爆击伤害加成提高20%。
description.en: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Sinister Strike, Gouge, Backstab, Mutilate, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities by 20%.

description.zh: 使你的毒素所造成的伤害提高20%，并使你的毒药抵抗驱散效果的几率提高40%。
description.en: Increases the damage dealt by your poisons by 20% and gives your poisons an additional 40% chance to resist dispel effects.

description.zh: 激活后，使你的下一次邪恶攻击、背刺、伏击、刺骨或毁伤的爆击几率提高100%。
description.en: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%.

description.zh: 使你对目标施加毒药的几率提高10%，并使毒药生效时有50%的几率不消耗使用次数。
description.en: Increases the chance to apply Poisons to your target by 10%, and gives Poison applications a 50% chance to not consume a charge.

description.zh: 使你的能量值上限提高10点。
description.en: Increases your maximum Energy by 10.

description.zh: 立即使用双手武器攻击，造成75%的武器伤害，每把武器额外造成17.25点伤害。对中毒目标造成的伤害提高20%。奖励2个连击点数。
description.en: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 75% weapon damage plus an additional 17.25 with each weapon. Damage increased by 20% against Poisoned targets. Awards 2 Combo Points.

description.zh: 被你的肾击昏迷的敌人，受到你的毒药和攻击的伤害提高10%。
description.en: Enemies Stunned by your Kidney Shot ability take 10% increased damage from your poisons and attacks.

description.zh: 可增加连击点数的技能造成爆击时，有100%的几率额外增加一个连击点数。
description.en: Your critical strikes from abilities that add Combo Points have a 100% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

description.zh:
终结技，使你的毒药造成的伤害提高30%，毒药施加几率提高10%。连击点数越多，持续时间越长：
1点：9秒
2点：12秒
3点：15秒
4点：18秒
5点：21秒
description.en:
Finishing move that increases the damage of your Poisons by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 10%. Lasts longer per combo point:
1 point : 9 sec
2 points: 12 sec
3 points: 15 sec
4 points: 18 sec
5 points: 21 sec

description.zh: 使你的刺骨技能所造成的伤害提高20%。
description.en: Increases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by 20%.

description.zh: 使你的邪恶攻击技能所消耗的能量值减少5点。
description.en: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sinister Strike ability by 5.

description.zh: 使你的躲闪几率提高5%。
description.en: Increases your Dodge chance by 5%.

description.zh: 使你的背刺爆击几率提高30%、毁伤爆击几率提高15%，并使背刺有45%的几率额外增加一个连击点数。
description.en: Increases the critical strike chance of your Backstab by 30% and your Mutilate by 15%, and gives Backstab a 45% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

description.zh: 使你的招架几率提高6%。
description.en: Increases your Parry chance by 6%.

description.zh: 使你击中目标的几率提高3%。
description.en: Improves your chance to hit by 3%.

description.zh: 使你的疾跑和闪避技能冷却时间缩短60%。
description.en: Reduces the cooldown of your Sprint and Evasion abilities by 60%.

description.zh: 在招架了敌人的攻击之后可以使用的技能，对目标造成150%的武器伤害，并使其被缴械，持续直到取消。
description.en: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 150% weapon damage and disarms the target for until cancelled.

description.zh: 使你在启动疾跑技能时有100%的几率移除所有移动限制效果。
description.en: Gives a 100% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when you activate your Sprint ability.

description.zh: 使你的脚踢技能有100%的几率令目标沉默2秒。
description.en: Gives your Kick ability a 100% chance to Silence the target for 2 sec.

description.zh: 使你的刺骨消耗的能量值降低10点。
description.en: Reduces the Energy cost of your Eviscerate ability by 10.

description.zh: 使你的副手武器造成的伤害提高25%。
description.en: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 25%.

description.zh: 使你的近战攻击速度提高20%，并使你的近战攻击命中附近的一个额外对手。持续15秒。
description.en: Increases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec.

description.zh:
使你的近战武器攻击根据武器类型获得不同增益。

斧/剑：你的成功近战攻击有5%的几率对目标触发一次额外攻击。

匕首/拳套：使你的爆击几率提高5%。

锤：你的攻击无视
目标15%的护甲值。
description.en:
Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon.

Axe/Sword: Your successful melee attacks have a 5% chance to trigger an extra attack on the target.

Dagger/Fist: Increases your critical strike chance by 5%.

Mace: Your attacks ignore 15% of your target's armor.

description.zh: 使你的攻击被躲闪或招架的几率降低2%。
description.en: Reduces the chance for your attacks to be Dodged or Parried by 2%.

description.zh: 使你的影袭、背刺和刺骨技能的伤害提高6%。
description.en: Increases the damage of your Sinister Strike, Backstab, and Eviscerate abilities by 6%.

description.zh: 使你的能量值回复速度提高100%，持续15秒。
description.en: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.

description.zh: 使你潜行时的移动速度惩罚降低15%，并使潜行的冷却时间缩短6秒。
description.en: Reduces your speed penalty from your Stealth ability by 15% and reduces its cooldown by 6 sec.

description.zh: 当你在潜行状态下时，降低敌人侦测到你的几率，等同于你的等级提高了3级。
description.en: Reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while in Stealth mode as if you were 3 levels higher.

description.zh: 使你的背刺、绞喉、伏击和毁伤技能造成的伤害提高10%。
description.en: Increases the damage dealt by your Backstab, Garrote, Ambush, and Mutilate abilities by 10%.

description.zh: 使你在躲闪攻击或完全抵抗法术后有100%的几率为目标增加一个连击点数。
description.en: Gives you a 100% chance to add a Combo Point to your target after Dodging one of their attacks or fully resisting one of their spells.

description.zh: 使你的消失和致盲技能的冷却时间缩短90秒。
description.en: Reduces the cooldown of your Vanish and Blind abilities by 90 sec.

description.zh: 使你的闷棍和致盲技能消耗的能量值减少50%。
description.en: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sap and Blind abilities by 50%.

description.zh: 使你的伏击技能造成爆击的几率提高45%。
description.en: Increases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by 45%.

description.zh: 使你有100%的几率在使用伏击、绞喉或偷袭技能后获得1个额外的连击点数。
description.en: Gives you a 100% chance to add an additional combo point to your target when using your Ambush, Garrote, or Cheap Shot ability.

description.zh: 打击敌人，造成125%（主手装备匕首时为180%）武器伤害，并使你的躲闪几率提高15%，持续7秒。奖励1个连击点。
description.en: A strike that deals 125% (180% if a Dagger is equipped in your Main Hand) weapon damage and increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec. Awards 1 combo point.

description.zh: 使你的扰乱技能的作用范围增加5码，并进一步降低被扰乱敌人的潜行侦测能力，使其相当于降低了2个等级。
description.en: Increases the radius of your Distract ability by 5 yds, and further reduces the Stealth detection of distracted enemies as though they were an additional 2 levels lower.

description.zh: 使你的潜行侦测相当于提高3级，并使你被法术和远程攻击命中的几率降低4%。
description.en: Increases your Stealth detection as if you were 3 levels higher and reduces your chance to be hit by spells and ranged attacks by 4%.

description.zh: 为目标增加2个连击点数。你必须在20秒内使用或叠加这些连击点数，否则它们将会消失。
description.en: Adds 2 Combo Points to your target. You must add to or use those combo points within 20 sec or the combo points are lost.

description.zh: 使你的攻击忽略目标9%的护甲，并使你的割裂技能造成的伤害提高30%。
description.en: Causes your attacks to ignore 9% of your target's Armor and increases the damage dealt by your Rupture ability by 30%.

description.zh: 使你的偷袭和绞喉消耗的能量值降低20点，且绞喉不再要求你位于目标身后。
description.en: Reduces the Energy cost of your Cheap Shot and Garrote abilities by 20, and your Garrote ability no longer requires you to be behind your target.

description.zh: 激活之后，这项技能立刻令你的其它潜行者技能的冷却时间结束。
description.en: When activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your other Rogue abilities.

description.zh: 发动瞬发打击，造成100%武器伤害（装备匕首时为145%），并使目标受到来自游荡者的割裂伤害提高15%，持续15秒。奖励1个X连击点数。
description.en: An instant strike that deals 100% weapon damage (145% if a Dagger is equipped) and causes the target to take 15% increased Rupture damage from the Rogue. Lasts 15 sec. Awards 1 Combo Point.

description.zh: 你的邪恶攻击、鬼魅攻击和出血对生命值低于35%的目标造成的伤害提高10%。
description.en: Your Sinister Strike, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities cause 10% more damage against targets below 35% health.

description.zh: 你的背刺有15%的几率使你在10秒内的下一个伏击不需要潜行。
description.en: Your Backstab has a 15% chance to cause your next Ambush within 10 sec to not require Stealth.

description.zh: 你的割裂造成周期性伤害时，使你在10秒内的下一个出血或背刺的能量消耗降低3点，最多叠加5次。
description.en: When your Rupture ability deals periodic damage, the Energy cost of your next Hemorrhage or Backstab ability within 10 sec is reduced by 3, stacking up to 5 times.
